# Variable `RECIPE_SYSROOT_NATIVE`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

This is similar to RECIPE_SYSROOT but files in it are provided by native recipes. This allows a recipe built for the target machine to use native tools.

This variable is used to define STAGING_DIR_NATIVE.

The default value is `"${WORKDIR}/recipe-sysroot-native"`. Do not modify it.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-RECIPE_SYSROOT_NATIVE
